title: Correct Plank/Squash calendar-month time progression in optimistic UI

requirements.summary: Adjust frontend month-to-month volume derivation so Plank progresses +15s per calendar month and Squash stays constant at 45:00 across all months, without affecting other habits.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user sets Plank’s volume for February to 1:15, the app shows March = 1:30 and April = 1:45 (and continues +15s for subsequent months), without unexpected jumps.
When a user sets Squash’s volume (in any month) to 45:00 (or 45), the app shows 45:00 for every month (Jan–Dec).
The month-to-month behavior is based on calendar months (Jan–Dec), not on a user-specific training-month counter.
Other habits keep their current compounding/increment rules and are unaffected by this change.
After saving and refreshing, Plank and Squash volumes remain correct (values are persisted and reloaded correctly).

file_operations.description: Update optimistic month compounding rules to (1) treat Squash as constant across all 12 calendar months (not just future months) and (2) ensure Plank’s per-month progression is computed strictly as +15 seconds per calendar month from the edited month. Ensure other habits retain existing behavior.

requirements.summary: Make the frontend optimistic volume compounding used during edits match the corrected calendar-month rules for Plank and Squash while leaving other habits unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: After editing Plank’s volume in the UI for a given month, the immediately-updated (optimistic) UI values for other months reflect the correct +15s/month progression based on calendar months.
After editing Squash’s volume in the UI, the immediately-updated (optimistic) UI values show 45:00 for all months.
The optimistic UI matches what is shown after the backend response/refresh (no mismatch between optimistic and persisted values).

file_operations.description: Refine computeCompoundedVolumeTracking so that when a timeString is provided during an edit, the optimistic model uses unitType="time" for the compounding calculation (even if existing unitType is incorrect), preventing reps-style compounding in the optimistic UI for time habits.

Align the optimistic update in useUpdateHabitVolume with the adjusted compounding rules (Plank +15s per calendar month, Squash constant across Jan–Dec) so the immediately-updated UI matches the persisted/refresh state.
